definitions.gloss: appearing, performing (in a show, film, or on stage)
definitions.explanation: The act of appearing or performing in a movie, TV show, play, concert, or other public performance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出演|しゅつえん}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ドラマ→ドラマ：03867_dorama⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出演|しゅつえん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A famous actor will appear in the drama.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{十|じゅう}→十：00708_juu⟧{本|ほん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出演|しゅつえん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧おり、⟦{来年|らいねん}→来年：00745_rainen⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{新作|しんさく}→新作：09523_shinsaku⟧⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出演|しゅつえん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{決|き}まっている→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧。
examples.english: She has appeared in ten films so far, and her appearance in a new one next year has been confirmed.

notes:
Compound of {出|しゅつ} (to go out) + {演|えん} (perform). A standard term for professional appearances in entertainment.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出演|しゅつえん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to appear in, to perform in)
- {出演|しゅつえん}{者|しゃ} (performer, cast member)
- {出演|しゅつえん}{料|りょう} (performance fee, appearance fee)
- {出演|しゅつえん}{作|さく} (work one has appeared in)
- ⟦ゲスト→ゲスト：10849_gesuto⟧{出演|しゅつえん} (guest appearance)
- ⟦{初|はつ}→初：10632_hatsu⟧{出演|しゅつえん} (first appearance, debut)
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出演|しゅつえん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to appear in ~)

USAGE:
The particle ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ marks the work or program: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{出演|しゅつえん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (appear in a movie). Note that {出演|しゅつえん} refers to acting or performing, not simply attending an event as a spectator.
